decks.notes: This deck focuses on using Underworld Breach to combo with Grinding Station, Malevolent Rumble, and Emry, Lurker of the Loch to mill through the deck quickly and win with Thassa's Oracle. The deck also utilizes artifacts and spells to generate mana and control the board, while Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student helps dig for combo pieces. The goal is to assemble the combo pieces quickly and efficiently to overwhelm the opponent and win the game before they have a chance to react.

This deck focuses on quickly ramping up mana with Eldrazi Temples and other mana sources to cast powerful Eldrazi creatures like Ulamog and Emrakul. It also uses control elements like All Is Dust and Ugin's Labyrinth to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with massive Eldrazi threats while controlling the board and ensuring a quick victory. Abstergo Entertainment and Palantír of Orthanc provide additional utility and card advantage to further enhance the deck's strategy.

This deck focuses on quickly building a board presence with aggressive creatures like Ragavan and Guide of Souls, while also providing support with cards like Ajani and Thraben Charm. The inclusion of Galvanic Discharge and Goblin Bombardment helps keep pressure on the opponent, while Static Prison and Arena of Glory provide disruption and protection. Seasoned Pyromancer and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker offer card advantage and additional threats. Phelia, Exuberant Shepherd and Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury serve as finishers to close out the game. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with fast, efficient threats and versatile removal.

The deck aims to quickly assemble a combo involving cards like Underworld Breach, Grinding Station, and Jeskai Ascendancy to generate massive card advantage, mana, and eventually win the game by milling opponents or by utilizing alternative win conditions such as Jace, Wielder of Mysteries. The deck also incorporates various artifacts and planeswalkers to support the combo pieces and provide additional value. The key strategy revolves around efficiently utilizing the graveyard, casting spells for free, and chaining multiple spells together to overwhelm opponents before they can adequately respond.

The main concept of this Esper Control deck is to disrupt and control the opponent's game plan through a combination of removal spells, counterspells, and disruptive creatures. By efficiently removing threats, countering key spells, and utilizing creatures like Psychic Frog and Abhorrent Oculus to slow down the opponent's game plan, the deck aims to establish control of the game and grind out a win through attrition. The mana base is carefully constructed to provide the necessary colors to cast spells while avoiding color screw.

This aggro deck focuses on quickly putting pressure on the opponent with a mix of aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Guide of Souls, supported by removal spells like Galvanic Discharge and Thraben Charm. The deck also includes versatile cards like Expressive Iteration and Ranger-Captain of Eos for card advantage and flexibility. The key strategy is to maintain a fast pace and overwhelm the opponent before they can stabilize, utilizing cards like Goblin Bombardment and Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury for additional reach and damage potential.

The deck focuses on utilizing rituals and card draw effects to generate mana quickly and find key combo pieces. It includes cards like Pyretic Ritual, Manamorphose, and Desperate Ritual to ramp up mana production. Glimpse the Impossible and Ral, Monsoon Mage are used for card advantage and to dig for combo pieces. The deck also includes some interaction with Wish for additional versatility. The combo finish involves casting spells like Grapeshot with mana reduction effects from Ruby Medallion to deal lethal damage to the opponent in a single turn.

The deck focuses on using creatures with varying abilities and triggers to manipulate the board state and quickly fill up the graveyard. By cycling through the deck using cards like Architects of Will and Incubation / Incongruity, the goal is to eventually cast Living End and bring back a large number of powerful creatures from the graveyard to overwhelm the opponent. Additionally, utilizing cards like Splinter Twin and Force of Negation can provide additional control and protection to ensure the combo is successful.

This Naya Zoo deck focuses on overwhelming the opponent with aggressive creatures and burn spells. It utilizes efficient creatures like Wild Nacatl and Ocelot Pride, along with powerful planeswalkers like Ajani and Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury, to quickly reduce the opponent's life total. The deck also includes removal spells like Chained to the Rocks and Dromoka's Command to deal with opposing threats. The goal is to quickly establish a board presence and apply pressure, leading to a fast victory before the opponent can stabilize.

The deck focuses on utilizing cheap spells and powerful creatures to quickly assemble a combo win condition without relying on traditional lands. By manipulating the top of the library, countering opponent's spells, and generating massive amounts of mana, the deck aims to use Goblin Charbelcher's ability to deal lethal damage in a single turn. The key is to carefully manage resources and timing to execute the combo efficiently and effectively, overwhelming opponents before they can respond.

This deck focuses on quickly ramping up mana and efficiently using land tutors to consistently play Primeval Titan and trigger powerful land-related abilities. The goal is to assemble powerful land combinations, such as Valakut and Dryad of the Ilysian Grove, to deal massive amounts of damage to the opponent. With the help of Amulet of Vigor and various untap effects, this deck aims to create explosive turns and overwhelm the opponent with its land-based combos.

This Esper Control deck focuses on a heavy counter and removal strategy, utilizing cards like Spell Snare, Counterspell, and Fatal Push to control the board. The addition of cards like Picklock Prankster and Murktide Regent provide additional threats while Psychic Frog and Abhorrent Oculus offer card advantage and disruption. The mana base is optimized for consistency and allows for flexibility in casting spells of different colors. Overall, the deck aims to outlast and outmaneuver opponents through careful resource management and strategic decision-making.

The deck focuses on utilizing Underworld Breach alongside Emry, Lurker of the Loch and Mishra's Bauble to generate infinite mana and draw cards to ultimately win the game. Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student helps dig for combo pieces, while Urza's Saga can tutor for key artifacts like Grinding Station. Portable Hole and Soul-Guide Lantern provide disruption against opponents, while Mox Opal and Mox Amber accelerate mana development. The deck aims to set up its combo quickly and efficiently to overwhelm opponents and secure victory in the late game.

This deck focuses on aggressive plays and leveraging the power of Jeskai colored cards to overwhelm opponents quickly. It utilizes a mix of aggressive creatures, removal spells, and card advantage engines to maintain pressure on opponents and control the board. With a good balance of early game aggression and late game resilience, the deck aims to close out games efficiently while also being able to adapt to different matchups.

This deck focuses on utilizing a landless combo strategy to quickly and efficiently disrupt opponents and assemble a win condition. By using cards like Disrupting Shoal, Force of Negation, and Jwari Disruption to control the board, as well as cards like Goblin Charbelcher and Thundertrap Trainer to deal direct damage, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents before they can effectively respond. With a mix of counterspells, card draw, and powerful combo pieces, this deck seeks to outmaneuver opponents and secure victory through a fast-paced and synergistic approach.

The deck focuses on controlling the game through a combination of counterspells, removal, and disruptive spells. It aims to answer threats efficiently while generating value with card draw and planeswalker abilities. The inclusion of powerful control cards such as Teferi, Time Raveler and Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student, alongside flexible removal spells like Solitude, allows the deck to dictate the pace of the game and outvalue opponents. Additionally, the deck incorporates a mix of board wipes and targeted removal to handle a variety of threats, ensuring it can adapt to different matchups effectively.
